name: Unidentified Threat Actor
description:
2026-09-11 | Cyberattack Disrupts Port of Tanjung Pelepas Operations
Target: Port of Tanjung Pelepas (PTP), Malaysia (major transshipment hub adjacent to Singapore/Malacca Strait)
Vector: Unknown / Under investigation; targeted port management networks and infrastructure
Impact: Forced emergency shutdown of digital management systems and operational technology (OT), halting automated terminal operating systems, vessel berthing coordination, gantry crane movements, gate processing, and customs feeds, triggering regional supply chain logjams.
